# ORIGINAL PROMPT:

integrated_multimodal_description:
Generate one physically continuous transition from the preserved ending of the first source video to the preserved beginning of the second source video. Continue naturally from the first endpoint, evolve the action and camera path through the generated middle, and arrive early enough for the motion and composition to settle naturally into the second endpoint. Preserve coherent identity, environment logic, lighting, motion, and audiovisual timing across the transition.

overall_soundscape:
Evolve the ambience and acoustic space naturally from the first endpoint toward the second endpoint.

non_diegetic_music:
Preserve any established musical character if present.

widgets_values:
***All three video sizes must be exact!!!!!! adjust until you know it will be correct.***

I run it through once set to a rough 1mp based on video aspect ratio then check the dimensions in the preview image and set it from there. Must be divisible by 32 but that will be forced in the image preview.

set videos to match sizes and add same size to the image to video node.

dont add frames as this is making 192 frames AV Bridge so leave length set to that regardless of length of videos in.

if all videos are not exactly the same size (including what you send to the "image to video" node, it will error going into Sampler or at the end. 

trying to get to 1824 x 736 ooms my setup but with a error that is an oom.

1600 x 640 (1mp) finishes in 20 mins.

If you video sizes are odd, then find closest same aspect ratio to 1mp, and use those dimensions. it will adjust to divislble by 32. 


---

The challenge is to get it up to high resolution enough to use but then 15 seconds long result will have to be blended in post or something coz probably cant run 15 seconds through upscalers.

MB- Workflows error if there is no audio in the inbound videos. If you get that then add any audio file to this and set duration to match your total video length (it will repeat if you do it less).

This is just to avoid the show stopping error. I dont use audio in my videos as I do it in post.
